briefing: - BIND、Strapi 已入 KEV，确认在野利用，须立即处置。
- BIND EPSS 达 0.91，优先修复，其次 Citrix 边界设备。
- 本批未见勒索软件关联，但高危 RCE 与认证缺陷密集。
- 批量公告含多枚 9.8/10.0 分 RCE、SQL 注入和缺失认证。
- PraisonAI 10.0 代码注入已修复，尽快升级至 1.6.78。

items.title: Strapi 管理员面板信息泄露
items.title_zh: Strapi 管理员面板信息泄露
items.summary_zh: 拥有管理面板权限的攻击者可滥用查询过滤器，获取敏感用户信息。
items.action_zh: 升级到 4.8.0 或更高版本
items.repro_note: 入口：管理面板用户查询；需管理员权限；滥用 filters 过滤参数
items.impact_scope: CMS 后台，管理员权限利用
items.description: Strapi through 4.5.5 allows attackers (with access to the admin panel) to discover sensitive user details by exploiting the query filter. If the attacker has admin panel access to an account with permission to access the username and email of API users with a lower privileged role (e.g., Editor or Author), then this can be exploited to discover sensitive information for all API users but not other admin accounts.

items.title: Malcolm 代理路径授权绕过
items.title_zh: Malcolm 代理路径授权绕过
items.summary_zh: 已认证低权限用户构造特殊路径，绕过 RBAC 访问管理员或受限接口。
items.action_zh: 应用厂商补丁；临时限制管理端点访问
items.repro_note: 入口：反向代理管理端点；前置：低权账户；构造非规范化路径绕过 RBAC
items.impact_scope: 内网代理，横向访问管理面
items.description: Malcolm's nginx based reverse proxy contains a URL path normalization inconsistency between its Lua based role-based access control (RBAC) authorization layer and nginx's own request routing logic. An authenticated user can craft a specially formatted request path to bypass role-based restrictions and reach administrative or role gated endpoints they should not have access to.

items.title: NetBoard CRM SQL 注入
items.title_zh: NetBoard CRM SQL 注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者向恢复接口 user-name 参数注入 SQL，可窃取或篡改 CRM 数据。
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版；参数化查询过滤 user-name
items.repro_note: 入口：recovery.php；参数 user-name；SQL 注入
items.impact_scope: CRM 演示平台，数据泄露风险
items.description: SQL injection in the NetBoard CRM demo platform; specifically, the vulnerable component is the ‘user-name’ POST parameter in the ‘/module/auth/recovery.php’ endpoint. The parameter is vulnerable to blind attacks based on Boolean, error, time-based and UNION techniques. Exploitation allows attackers to extract confidential information (such as the version and type of backend used), alter data or further compromise the CRM environment.

items.title: SGLang ZMQ 反序列化 RCE
items.title_zh: SGLang ZMQ 反序列化 RCE
items.summary_zh: 启用数据并行注意力时，攻击者向 ZMQ 解码器发送 Pickle 载荷，反序列化执行代码。
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版；禁用数据并行注意力或隔离 ZMQ

items.impact_scope: AI 推理服务，可执行任意代码
items.description: SGLang contains an arbitrary code execution vulnerability caused by the ZMQ message decoder unconditionally deserializing PickleWrapper payloads via pickle.loads() in _maybe_unwrap_pickle without type allowlisting or authentication; this vulnerability persists via the msgpack path even when SGLANG_USE_PICKLE_IPC is disabled, and becomes remotely exploitable if data-parallel attention is enabled with a non-loopback --dist-init-addr setting.

items.repro_note: 调用get()传入constructor.constructor路径执行JS
items.impact_scope: Node.js依赖库，可远程命令执行
items.description: dot-access 0.0.3 through 1.0.0 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute JavaScript by supplying crafted paths to get(). The path is concatenated into a new Function body in index.js, so attackers can reach constructor.constructor to load child_process and run operating system commands in the Node.js process.

items.title: node-convert命令注入RCE
items.title_zh: node-convert命令注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者向filepath/convertTo注入shell元字符，经exec执行系统命令，控制Node进程。
items.action_zh: 升级node-convert；避免exec拼接，校验文件路径参数
items.repro_note: 调用convert，向filepath或convertTo注入单引号或;等字符
items.impact_scope: Node.js图像转换服务，命令执行
items.description: @enmaso/node-convert through 1.0.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in convert.js that allows attackers to execute shell commands via unsanitized filepath and convertTo arguments. Attackers can inject shell metacharacters or a single quote into the ImageMagick command run by child_process.exec() to execute operating system commands with Node.js process privileges.

items.title: image_optimizer命令注入
items.title_zh: image_optimizer命令注入
items.summary_zh: 启用identify选项时，攻击者传入恶意图片路径，经命令注入执行系统命令。
items.action_zh: 升级image_optimizer；关闭identify选项并校验图片路径
items.repro_note: 启用identify后传入含元字符的图片路径
items.impact_scope: Ruby图像处理依赖，命令执行
items.description: The image_optimizer Ruby gem 1.3.0 through 1.9.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in ImageOptimizer#identify_format that allows attackers to execute commands by supplying a crafted image path when the identify option is enabled. Attackers controlling the path, such as an uploaded file name, can append shell metacharacters like ';' that are executed via Ruby backticks with the Ruby process privileges.

items.title: TVU设备登录认证绕过
items.title_zh: TVU设备登录认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 远程未认证攻击者可向/tvu/Login提交空UserName，获取管理会话并接管设备。
items.action_zh: 升级固件至7.9以上；限制管理Web暴露并禁用空用户名登录
items.repro_note: 未授权POST /tvu/Login，省略或置空UserName参数
items.impact_scope: 网络音视频设备，管理口暴露风险
items.description: TVU Networks Receiver/Transceiver devices running firmware before version 7.9 contain an authentication bypass vulnerability in the web management login endpoint POST /tvu/Login that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to obtain an administrative session by submitting an empty or absent UserName parameter.

items.title: IBM Guardium边缘控制器缺失认证
items.title_zh: IBM Guardium边缘控制器缺失认证
items.summary_zh: 远程未认证攻击者可利用edge-controller缺失认证执行任意容器镜像，控制边缘集群。
items.action_zh: 升级至IBM官方修复版本；限制edge-controller网络访问
items.repro_note: 访问edge-controller未授权接口，提交任意容器镜像执行
items.impact_scope: IBM数据保护边缘集群，横向接管
items.description: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.1 and 12.2.2 are vulnerable to missing authentication in the edge-controller component. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary container images and gain control of managed edge clusters.

items.title: GLUE任务接口缺失认证RCE
items.title_zh: GLUE任务接口缺失认证RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者向/jobinfo/addAndStart提交GLUE任务与glueSource，可在执行器主机执行命令。
items.action_zh: 限制/jobinfo/addAndStart访问并启用认证，更新修复版本
items.repro_note: 未授权POST /jobinfo/addAndStart并提交GLUE任务源
items.impact_scope: 任务调度执行器，可命令执行横向
items.description: Dromara Skyeye through commit 003549ae5615bd114ba5bb8ddf6a8e8ead97c321 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in bundled xxl-job-admin JobInfoController endpoints annotated with @PermissionLimit(limit = false). Unauthenticated attackers can POST GLUE_SHELL, GLUE_PYTHON, or GLUE_POWERSHELL jobs with attacker-supplied glueSource to /jobinfo/addAndStart, executing commands on the executor host or stopping and deleting jobs.

items.title: Skyeye TTS接口未授权命令注入
items.title_zh: Skyeye TTS接口未授权命令注入
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者通过format参数注入单引号，突破PowerShell执行命令，控制Windows服务账户。
items.action_zh: 限制TTS接口访问，修复format参数过滤并更新版本
items.repro_note: 未授权调用/textToSpeech，format参数注入单引号
items.impact_scope: Windows业务系统，服务账户RCE
items.description: Dromara Skyeye through commit 003549ae5615bd114ba5bb8ddf6a8e8ead97c321 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the unauthenticated /post/TtsController/textToSpeech endpoint via the format parameter. Attackers can inject a single quote into format to break out of the PowerShell string and execute commands as the Skyeye service account on Windows.

items.title: 参数拼接注入
items.description: An authenticated high privilege user can inject arguments in troubleshooting commands resulting in privilege escalation.

items.title: CWE-693
items.description: IBM Security Verify Access 10.0 through 10.0.9.2 and IBM Verify Identity Access 11.0 through 11.0.3 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code due to a protection mechanism failure.
